note: Two primitive camping spots, each beside a gravel parking lot with no pads, tables or toilet. This pin is the south one, at the end of the area road from Scott Road beside South Moreau Creek (the creek is about 40 m off through the bank trees). The other is at the larger lot on the area's north-west corner off Claywell Road. Multi-use trails that take horses, a shooting range and 9-acre Winegar Lake are elsewhere on the area. --Claude
summary: Stays under the lot rule: two Primitive Camping points (map symbols + GIS), each at a single gravel lot. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. PHONE MISMATCH flagged. The two points are 2.08 km apart but each is one lot, so no split proposed. Not waterfront stands.
flags: PHONE MISMATCH (apply.py does not write it): stored 573-815-7900; the area page says 'For more information call (573) 346-2210'.

INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites.' The map (5/24/2021) draws a Primitive Camping symbol beside a Parking Lot symbol at two places. GIS layer 27: 38.47293,-92.38864 (= stored pin; lot 27 m away at 38.47269,-92.38860) and 38.48990,-92.39859 (lot at 38.49012,-92.39844). Imagery, south: a gravel lot about 15 m across at the end of the gravel area road, beside a crop field, the point in the trees at its edge. North: a gravel lot about 35 x 20 m beside the county road with a vehicle parked, the point at its south-west corner on rough grass. Neither has pads or a loop.

SPLIT (not proposed): the north point is 2,078 m from the pin on a different road, but it is a single lot with nothing more, which the split rule excludes. No other campgrounds.json entry sits at it. Say if it should be its own entry anyway.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. South Moreau Creek is about 40 m east of the south lot behind a continuous belt of bank trees; a creek, not counted.
PIN: on the south GIS point by its lot. No move.
